about: One row per platform. requires = asset ids from scripts/scan.py ASSETS (a|b means either). dr = claimed domain rating (unverified unless verified=yes). steps: claude = Claude does it locally; approve = Claude runs it after an explicit yes (publish, PR, upload); human = the user does it (accounts, payment, DNS, forms, email). see = pointer to the fact's other home instead of steps.

approve: npx -y clawhub@0.25.1 skill publish ./<skill> --slug <product>-<skill> --version 0.1.0 --source-repo <owner>/<repo> --source-path <path> (one per skill; --dry-run first)
platforms.notes: One listing per skill folder, so a skill that reads files from a sibling needs a fallback. Prefix slugs with the product name. Check state with clawhub inspect <slug>. Malicious skills were found on ClawHub in Feb 2026; keep the source public. Publish from a clean `git archive` export of the pushed commit (local __pycache__ otherwise uploads), excluding any .claude-plugin/ in the skill folder: with a plugin.json present the CLI refuses with 'This looks like a plugin' (observed 2026-11-08). Pass --owner and --source-repo/--source-commit/--source-path so the listing records the repo.
